seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Neither candidate holds CA-3. Bera currently represents CA-6 (2023 lines). Kevin Kiley, the current CA-3 member, is running in the new CA-6. Primary: Bera about 34%, Tucker about 30% (Greenberg Traurig). Bera's designation (United States Congressman) came from jumbled PDF text, and another summary showed no designation for him, so verify it. In the extracted cert-list text, a Kevin Kiley No Party Preference entry appeared right after the District 3 block, but other sources place Kiley in District 6. Conflict on Bera's associate dean role: his official site and a 2004 GPO profile say UC Davis (2004-2008); a House Clerk/history entry reportedly lists UC Irvine (2004-2007). His birth date (March 2, 1965) is in the House history entry per the search summary. Tucker: one CaliforniaLocal listing labels him District 5 supervisor; The Union says District 2. That he was born and raised in Nevada County is reported only by news, so it is omitted from facts.
